text: The Committee supports our Investigator’s belief that the most productive areas have already been developed and that any future areas are unlikely to pay major dividends in terms of operational effectiveness or financial savings

This view is shared by the Home Secretary, but we understand that this is unlikely to be possible for some time because of other higher priorities, most notably international Counter-Terrorism work. *** have been devoting additional effort to countering Serious Organised Crime, which has resulted in the breaking up of some people-smuggling networks in Europe and the seizure of significant amounts of class A drugs
